$comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the public site catalogue — what a person can visit. Hand-edited. index.html's `var P` is GENERATED from this file by scripts/gen-landing-catalogue.mjs --write; do not edit var P directly. Deploy ownership is NOT defined here: deploy-registry.json owns that, and each entry's `surface` field is a foreign key into it.

$fields.k: weight — drives orrery ring placement and sort order
$fields.p: parent entry name, when this is a sub-site

$order: entries[] order is the on-screen order of the landing page — preserve it. sections[] records the section comments emitted into var P, by entry index.
